_comment: `spec_rows` are the spec/target-spec.md row ids this bench's envelope is cited for in manifests/sg13cmos5l-bandgap.json; they must match the `spec_row` tags on the request's graded measurements.
criteria: Graded at every one of the 45 points: psrr_db > 50 dB, the ratified FALLBACK bound of the 'PSRR @ DC' row (decision record 0001 §5 names the fallback as the threshold a miss is judged against). The row's Target is > 60 dB and its Stretch > 70 dB; both are reported in README.md against the measured worst case, not graded here, so a target miss on a met fallback cannot render the whole grid 'failing'. psrr_db also carries a plausible_range of [0 dB, 140 dB], which fails a numerically-zero secant masquerading as infinite rejection.
